name: voz
description: Local English voice front desk for Claude Desktop sessions. Explicit on/off and pause/resume controls.

vozDir.title: Voice daemon folder
vozDir.description: Leave empty to use the included daemon.

autoStart.title: Start automatically
autoStart.description: Resume the designated voice session on startup. Off by default.

tts.title: Speech engine
tts.description: Local neural speech: Chatterbox Turbo, Qwen3 (mlx), or Kokoro. Claude remains the conversational brain.

spokenSentences.title: Spoken sentences
spokenSentences.description: How many sentences of each reply the voice speaks. 0 (the default) speaks the whole reply. A number from 1 to 20 speaks only that many sentences per text block, plus a final question in plain prose; the pane shows the full reply.

summaryMinutes.title: Meeting summary interval
summaryMinutes.description: Minutes between meeting summaries; 0 disables them.
